closure.means: a broad sweep of Metal memory constructs - eleven scalar widths, eleven vector widths, both address spaces, every atomic - emits 25 distinct memory forms. SEVENTEEN of them are ordinary device loads and stores, and every one is determined here by execution. What remains is the threadgroup address space, which this runner cannot allocate, and the atomics, which are a family of their own

not_reached.why_atomic: the atomics are a family of their own and are measured by tools/g17atomicprobe.py, not here

control.means: C[i] must equal A[i] on every lane. The batch is void without it: a harness that is not delivering the buffer would make every law below fail identically, which reads as a discovery

extension.rule: a signed byte load SIGN-EXTENDS and an unsigned byte load ZERO-EXTENDS: the same byte 0xFF reads as 0xFFFFFFFF signed and 0x000000FF unsigned. The extension is a property of the instruction the compiler selects, not of the byte

means: what a load and a store DO, measured by executing vendor-compiled kernels and reading the buffer back. The form under test is named by decoding the program that ran, so a result belongs to the encoding that actually executed

tg_store_4.note: a THREADGROUP store, read back through a threadgroup load at the SAME displacement. If the store honours it, the round trip is the identity; if it ignores it, the value read comes from another slot. The device output is only the window onto the threadgroup array
refuted: no displacement: the store writes elsewhere and the read finds A[i + 4]
the store writes at i - 4: the read finds A[i - 4]

separation.why: every pair of laws predicts a different output buffer on these inputs

survivors: element displacement: the store writes where the displacement says

refuted: byte displacement: word w reads word w + k/4
no displacement: word w reads word w

zero_extend_uchar_negative.note: byte 4i+1 of B is 0xFF. Read UNSIGNED this must give 0x000000FF; its signed companion gives 0xFFFFFFFF on the same byte, so the pair separates zero extension from sign extension on a byte that is actually negative

separation.why: this probe offers no competing laws; it CHARACTERISES

zero_extend_uchar_negative.status: refused: the observable is CONSTANT (0x000000FF on every slot), so this probe measured nothing. For a threadgroup access that is the harness declaring no threadgroup allocation, which makes every read zero

threadgroup_not_reachable: the THREADGROUP address space is out of reach of this harness, and the probes for it are refused rather than reported. `ac_run_ps_es` declares no threadgroup allocation, so a threadgroup array has no storage, every read returns zero and every law is refuted - which would read as a finding about the instruction and is a fact about the runner. Reaching `12364/14`, `13288/10` and `12682/8` needs a dispatch path that calls setThreadgroupMemoryLength
what_this_is_not: not a measurement of any address the compiler would not generate. Displacements outside what Apple emits, misaligned accesses it did not choose, and out-of-range indices are all beyond this instrument, and the authored path that could reach them is the one the gate refuses
why_this_instrument: g17safe refuses every load, store and atomic OPCODE, and that gate is about AUTHORED encodings - bytes this project wrote, pointed at an address nobody checked. It is not a claim that memory instructions cannot run: every lane probe in this repository contains a load and a store, which is why they are in the boilerplate set. Here the vendor compiler chooses the address and the buffer is read back
